scriptComments: Ghosts Modes:-1 = Inactive0 = Chase1 = Scatter2 = Freightened

To allow ms pacman to move through the portals, we need to keep resetting the detected position to the grid's limit. Ms Pacman will still be allowed to move past the grid's limits since she'll be sitting on the specialized tile of 2.

NOTE: Some of these script blocks are insanely long intentionally. It's done for performance. Broadcasts fork the code and are too expensive.There are a lot of variables for a few reasons:1) Many of the variables are used to tweak timing and gameplay during development. It's easier to change a value in one place, usually at the top of scripts.2) Variables reduce the number of "magic" numbers in code. This means the variables themselves help to document what's going on.  If the variable names are descriptive enough, they self-document. I could have done a better job.3) Since the code is not very modular and reuse is at a minimum, there's a lot of state to maintain in variables. :( It's in the name of performance usually.4) The priority for the game is to closely resemble the original game, perform well, be playable, and not take up the rest of my life to develop. Code quality probably suffers as a result and I'm not planning on refactoring for maintenance sake. Someone can remix for that reason if they like.

The long script block that handles the "Blinky Service Loop" broadcast can crash Scratch.TIPS TO AVOID CRASHING SCRATCH IDEApply these tips while on the Ghosts' Scripts tab.- Do not drag the scrollbar. Click the empty part of the scrollbar to scroll a page at a time.- Pause a few seconds between clicks, especially on the scrollbar.- Drag blocks SLOWLY and wait until Scratch responds before dragging long distances.- MOST IMPORANT: break the large "Service Loop" script block up into 2 or more pieces, make your changes, then put the block back together.- SAVE OFTEN- Avoid scrolling upwards. It's better to save and let Scratch reset you to the top of the page or to click onto another sprite and then back onto this one.- Avoid editing text fields on blocks that are part of large script blocks. Try breaking the block out, make your edit, and then reattach it.

this is how we'll track individual ghosts  being scared or not2 is frightened0 is normal(chased)when a dot is eaten, if eyes are not 0, then that ghost was just eaten and is on its way home. we can't change it back to blue unless it's at home or on it's way out, or out

info.comment: 8/1/12 - Ghosts hang out in monster pen now. Fixed a few bugs. Levels go to 53 now.DEBUG KEYS (when level is in progress):P = pause game (press P again to resume)R = rack test (jumps to next level)L = jump to specified levelG = show underlying grid data (press G again to resume)remaining bugs/work:- ms pacman can go through ghosts- ghosts sometimes go off map- ghosts may still look frightened when they kill ms pacman just as the frightened cycle times out- when several ghosts occupy the same space as ms pacman, the order that ghosts will be eaten or kill ms pacman is not ranked by distance yet- ghosts sometime go out of map boundaries and travel across map lanes- movement of ghosts is jumpy- ghosts frightened time is not correct- ghosts don't leave monster pen correctly- timing and characters visible during level transitions needs adjusting- add remaining levels- add bonuses- add dot eaten sound change when just a few dots remain- Improve keyboard handling at intersections to avoid rapid direction and costume changes- ghosts can't always find monster pen on later maps- add ghost target debugging optionP.S. My sister would love a little comment on her project ;) http://scratch.mit.edu/projects/Banoa04/2669660
